name: umi-react-admin
description: umi max , React , antd5.x , tailwindcss , CSS in JS , TypeScript , ProComponents 编写的模版项目

paragraphs: umi-react-admin is an open-source admin template built on Umi Max 4 + React 19 + Ant Design 6 + ProComponents. Unlike most templates, its demo tells one coherent story: a fictional IoT monitoring platform — 240+ stations, 90 days of alarms, tickets derived from those alarms, 86 operators with role-based permissions and audit logs. Every number on the dashboard is aggregated live from those records, and holds up to scrutiny.
Fully bilingual (zh-CN / en-US), light/dark themes, mobile-friendly; every page has a "view source" link in the top-right corner.
Screenshots are from the 2026-10-12 demo walkthrough (more in docs/demo/screenshots/).

whatItDoes.text: umi-react-admin is an open-source admin template built on Umi Max 4 + React 19 + Ant Design 6 + ProComponents. Unlike most templates, its demo tells one coherent story: a fictional IoT monitoring platform — 240+ stations, 90 days of alarms, tickets derived from those alarms, 86 operators with role-based permissions and audit logs. Every number on the dashboard is aggregated live from those records, and holds up to scrutiny.

requirements.text: Live demo — one-click sign-in for five roles (admin / lead / operator / analyst / guest) sharing the same dataset, so you can compare permission differences across menus, buttons and API responses (see docs/demo/role-matrix.md).
The login token lives in the current tab's sessionStorage; modifications to the fictional business data persist as patches in localStorage, and the avatar menu offers "reset demo data".
